column1: # What a Debian 12 guest listens on before any service of ours is installed: the resolver,
# the DHCP client and sshd. From `ss -Htulnp` and `ss -s` as root in the class capture
# (capture/capture.sh, class kvm-epyc-2c-4g, 18 November 2026). Every class boots the same
# image with the same services, so one record serves them all. The recorded machine's own
# address and interface are slots; the process IDs are left out (the decoy takes them from
# its process list). Do not edit.
